name: nextcloud
description: Nextcloud office connector — Files (WebDAV), Notes, Calendar (CalDAV), Shares. Read + write lanes; writes_gated (declared writes are #106-bound, script-composed writes take per-invocation #126 approvals).

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Validate an app password against the instance and store the precomputed Authorization header. Get the app password from the animus-agent account (Settings → Security → Devices & sessions).
commands.script: function run(ctx) local h = 'Basic '..b64.encode(ctx.args.user..':'..ctx.args.app_password) local r = ctx.http.get(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/ocs/v2.php/cloud/user?format=json', {headers = {['Authorization'] = h, ['OCS-APIREQUEST'] = 'true', ['Accept'] = 'application/json'}}) if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'connect failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local o = r.json and r.json.ocs if not o or not o.data or not o.data.id then return {success = false, output = 'connect failed: unexpected OCS payload (HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..')'} end local ok1 = ctx.package.set_state('user', ctx.args.user) local ok2 = ctx.package.set_state('auth_header', h) if not ok1 or not ok2 then return {success = false, output = 'connect failed: state persist error'} end return {output = 'connected as '..o.data.id..' ('..tostring(o.data['display-name'])..')', data = {user_id = o.data.id}} end

commands.name: files list
commands.description: List files and folders in the account's root folder (PROPFIND, Depth 1)
commands.script: function run(ctx) local b = ctx.request.body or '' local rows = {} for resp in b:gmatch('<d:response>.-</d:response>') do local href = resp:match('<d:href>([^<]+)</d:href>') or '' local is_dir = resp:match('<d:resourcetype>%s*<d:collection') ~= nil local size = resp:match('<d:getcontentlength>([^<]+)<') or '' local mtime = resp:match('<d:getlastmodified>([^<]+)<') or '' local name = href:match('([^/]+)/?$') or href name = name:gsub('%%20', ' ') table.insert(rows, {name = name, type = is_dir and 'dir' or 'file', size = tonumber(size) or 0, modified = mtime, href = href}) end if #rows == 0 then return {success = false, output = 'files list: no response rows parsed - unexpected body shape (HTTP '..tostring(ctx.request.status)..')'} end return {output = #rows..' entries', data = rows} end

commands.name: file put
commands.description: Upload/overwrite a text file (raw-body PUT). Path is relative to the account root; percent-encode special characters (e.g. %20 for spaces).
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status ~= 201 and r.status ~= 204 then return {success = false, output = 'file put failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end return {output = 'wrote '..ctx.args.path..' (HTTP '..r.status..')'} end

commands.name: file delete
commands.description: Delete a file or folder (folder delete is recursive). Path relative to account root, percent-encoded as in file put.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status ~= 204 then return {success = false, output = 'file delete failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end return {output = 'deleted '..ctx.args.path} end

commands.name: note list
commands.script: function run(ctx) local rows = ctx.request.json if type(rows) ~= 'table' then return {success = false, output = 'note list: no JSON payload (HTTP '..tostring(ctx.request.status)..')'} end local out = {} for _, n in ipairs(rows) do table.insert(out, {id = n.id, title = n.title, modified = n.modified}) end return {output = #out..' notes', data = out} end

commands.name: note create
commands.description: Create a note with arbitrary text (Notes app). Body is script-composed via json.encode — per-invocation #126 approval applies (one-shot, payload-bound).
commands.script: function run(ctx) local body = json.encode({title = ctx.args.title, content = ctx.args.content}) local r = ctx.http.post(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/index.php/apps/notes/api/v1/notes', {headers = {['Authorization'] = ctx.package.get_state('auth_header'), ['Accept'] = 'application/json', ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'}, body = body}) if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'note create failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local j = r.json or {} return {output = 'note '..tostring(j.id)..': '..tostring(j.title), data = {id = j.id, title = j.title}} end

commands.name: cal list
commands.script: function run(ctx) local b = ctx.request.body or '' local rows = {} for resp in b:gmatch('<d:response>.-</d:response>') do local href = resp:match('<d:href>([^<]+)</d:href>') or '' local name = resp:match('<d:displayname>([^<]+)</d:displayname>') if name then table.insert(rows, {name = name, href = href}) end end if #rows == 0 then return {success = false, output = 'cal list: no calendars parsed - unexpected body shape (HTTP '..tostring(ctx.request.status)..')'} end return {output = #rows..' calendars', data = rows} end

commands.name: event put
commands.description: Create/overwrite a calendar event from VEVENT iCalendar text (raw-body PUT). calendar is the calendar id from cal list (e.g. personal); uid names the .ics resource and should match the VEVENT's UID.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status ~= 201 and r.status ~= 204 then return {success = false, output = 'event put failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end return {output = 'event '..ctx.args.uid..' written (HTTP '..r.status..')'} end

commands.name: share create
commands.description: Create a public link share for a file/folder path; returns the share URL. Body is script-composed — per-invocation #126 approval applies.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local body = json.encode({path = ctx.args.path, shareType = 3}) local r = ctx.http.post(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/shares?format=json', {headers = {['Authorization'] = ctx.package.get_state('auth_header'), ['OCS-APIREQUEST'] = 'true', ['Accept'] = 'application/json', ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'}, body = body}) if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'share create failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local d = r.json and r.json.ocs and r.json.ocs.data if not d or not d.url then return {success = false, output = 'share create: unexpected OCS payload'} end return {output = d.url, data = {id = d.id, url = d.url, token = d.token}} end
